title: Unvalidated Attribute Access
detail: This code raises an AttributeError for any dunder method access. While intended to prevent unexpected behavior, it could potentially mask legitimate attribute access errors or be exploited in unusual scenarios. It's a broad restriction without specific validation. The same applies to line 998.

title: Incorrect Host Cookie Validation
detail: The condition `not cookie.domain_specified and cookie.path_specified and cookie.path == '/'` for validating `__Host-` cookies is too restrictive. It requires the cookie to have a path of `/`, which might not always be the case for valid host cookies.
note: says the __Host- path rule is too strict, not the and
